#   vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/token_dispatcher.py    — prepare/preprocess/all2all/postprocess
#   vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/prepare_finalize.py    — truncate+pad+tp_split
#   vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/fused_moe.py           — 重复 _moe_sync_lora_context

pattern.code:
from typing import Optional
import torch
from vllm_ascend.ops.fused_moe.comm_utils import async_all_to_all

_MOE_LORA_INDEX_FIELDS = [
    "split_lora_indices", "permuted_lora_indices",
    "exchanged_lora_indices",
]

def reset_lora_indices(lora_context) -> None:
    """统一复位，替代 initialize_moe_lora_context_indices"""
    for field in _MOE_LORA_INDEX_FIELDS:
        setattr(lora_context, field, None)

def prepare_lora_indices(lora_context, *, num_tokens, pad_size, tp_size, tp_rank):
    """truncate+pad+tp_split 组合，替代 prepare_finalize.py 内联"""
    token_lora_indices = lora_context.punica_wrapper.token_lora_indices
    token_lora_indices = token_lora_indices[:num_tokens]
    if pad_size > 0:
        token_lora_indices = torch.nn.functional.pad(
            token_lora_indices, (0, pad_size), value=-1)
    lora_context.split_lora_indices = torch.tensor_split(
        token_lora_indices, tp_size, dim=0)[tp_rank]

def preprocess_lora_indices(lora_context, *, topk_ids, reversed_permutation_mapping):
    """expand+permute，替代 token_dispatcher._dispatch_preprocess 内联"""
    split_indices = getattr(lora_context, "split_lora_indices", None)
    if split_indices is not None:
        expanded = split_indices.repeat_interleave(topk_ids.shape[1])
        perm = torch.argsort(reversed_permutation_mapping.reshape(-1).long())
        lora_context.permuted_lora_indices = expanded[perm]

def all2all_lora_indices(lora_context, *, output_splits, input_splits, ep_group):
    """all2all 交换，替代 token_dispatch 主函数内联"""
    permuted = getattr(lora_context, "permuted_lora_indices", None)
    if permuted is not None:
        lora_dtype = permuted.dtype
        _, exchanged, handle = async_all_to_all(
            permuted.to(torch.int32), output_splits, input_splits, ep_group)
        handle.wait()
        lora_context.exchanged_lora_indices = exchanged.to(lora_dtype)

def postprocess_lora_indices(lora_context, *, reversed_permutation_mapping):
    """re-permute 还原，替代 token_dispatcher._dispatch_postprocess L675 内联"""
    exchanged = getattr(lora_context, "exchanged_lora_indices", None)
    if exchanged is not None:
        perm = torch.argsort(reversed_permutation_mapping.reshape(-1).long())
        lora_context.exchanged_lora_indices = exchanged[perm]

def sync_lora_context(quant_method, lora_context):
    """通信单例同步，替代 fused_moe.py 重复 _moe_sync_lora_context"""
    if hasattr(_EXTRA_CTX.moe_comm_method, "set_lora_context"):
        _EXTRA_CTX.moe_comm_method.set_lora_context(lora_context)
    if hasattr(quant_method, "set_lora_context"):
        quant_method.set_lora_context(lora_context)
